title: Self-replicating npm worm, 84 artifacts across 42 packages
summary: Modeled pack: the 42 packages, their 84 malicious versions, every publish time and every advisory time below are real records from the second Shai-Hulud wave, selected because they land inside one real 118 second burst that matches the track brief's figure of 84 malicious artifacts across 42 packages within six minutes. Constructed, and never presented as reported fact: the eight services with their descriptions and lockfile resolution times, and the framing of this burst as a self-contained incident rather than one slice of a wave that ran from 23 to 27 November 2025.

services.name: intent-etl
services.description: Nightly pipeline that flattens conversation transcripts into an intent warehouse.

services.name: conversation-api
services.description: Dialogue API that reaches the malicious base-types through the ^2.8.0 range in @voiceflow/general-types 3.2.21.

services.name: support-chat-web
services.description: Support chat frontend that reaches the malicious dtos-interact through the ^1 peer range in @voiceflow/sdk-runtime 1.43.0.

services.name: ci-lint-runner
services.description: Lint and format job that installs the shared config packages on every pipeline run.

services.name: voice-gateway
services.description: Voice channel gateway, refreshed five minutes before the maintainer started republishing clean versions.

services.name: transcript-archive
services.description: Cold storage writer whose lockfile was last touched three days before the burst.

services.name: billing-api
services.description: Usage billing API refreshed after the advisories landed, onto the republished line.

services.name: analytics-collector
services.description: Metrics collector rebuilt two days later, well after the clean republish.
